gap_corrections.name: agentMessage.questions/delivery/memoryCitation

gap_corrections.name: item/fileChange/patchUpdated; thread/settings/updated
gap_corrections.change: Existing notifications now update patches and model/effort settings.

gap_corrections.name: guardianWarning; autoApprovalReview/strictReviewRequired; modelProvider/authRecoveryStarted/Completed; thread/deleted/reverted
gap_corrections.change: Existing control/lifecycle notifications now surface quiet notices and status.

gap_corrections.name: currentTime/read
gap_corrections.change: Existing machine request is answered by the bridge with Unix seconds.

gap_corrections.name: account/chatgptAuthTokens/refresh; attestation/generate; applyPatchApproval; execCommandApproval; unknown future requests/modes
gap_corrections.change: Unimplemented credentials/attestation/legacy requests and future methods immediately receive JSON-RPC -32601; generic readable cards are terminal, never pending.

gap_corrections.name: experimental flags / recent gating
gap_corrections.change: All capability flags match stable versus experimental generated schemas; recent version gating removed in favor of observed -32601.

gap_corrections.name: ThreadStatus, TurnStatus, ThreadActiveFlag, ThreadTokenUsage, ReasoningEffort, ReasoningEffortOption, approval decisions, collaboration modes, plan/goal/hook shapes
gap_corrections.change: Unchanged between full generated versions; existing normalization, advertised decisions and authoritative plan/token-usage behavior preserved.

gap_corrections.name: MCP app resource embedding
gap_corrections.change: Click-only embedded MCP apps use an opposite-loopback static proxy, opaque inner frame, filtered CSP, fixed server/thread resource routing and per-call user approval. Remote resource targets remain unused.

gap_corrections.name: @openai/codex-sdk ^0.121.0
